sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's nickel downstreaming policy is structurally rerating renewable-linked miners like TOBA, as battery-grade material demand outpaces global supply through 2026.
TPIA's green ammonia and carbon capture pipeline positions it as a rare large-cap climate-tech proxy in IDX, benefiting from government's 2060 net-zero capex cycle.
US clean-tech volatility (PLUG, MPOW) creates entry points for Indonesian investors, but local names with domestic revenue—LAPD, PKPK—offer better risk-adjusted exposure to electrification subsidies.
sectors.ai: Indonesia renewables remain a selective long: TOBA's +7.55% confirms downstream nickel-solar integration momentum, while TPIA's +3.31% signals petrochemical-to-green transition pricing. US weakness (-1.86%) is a pull, not a trend reversal. Accumulate TOBA on dips below 1,500, hold TPIA for carbon-credit optionality, and avoid speculative LAPD/ARKO until earnings validate.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG

Structural shift toward food-away-from-home (NASI, CARS) and tech-enabled retail (NANO, BTEK) is accelerating, supported by rising urban middle-class spending and digital adoption.
sectors.ai: Buy selective small-cap FMCG names showing volume-driven re-rating (AGAR, BTEK, NAYZ) while large caps lag; US strength (+1.00%) supports export-linked consumer plays. Rotate into food-service and specialty retail sub-sectors with earnings momentum, avoid broad index exposure. Target 3-6 week horizon, set tight stops at 5% below entry given normal signal volatility.
